::: {#thm-perplexity-geometric-mean}
#### Perplexity is the geometric mean of the rarities

For a [discrete random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$,

$$\perplexityf{X} = \prod_x \rarityf{x}^{\P(X=x)}.$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\begin{aligned}
\perplexityf{X}
&= b^{\entropyf{X}}
&& \text{(definition of perplexity)} \\
&= b^{\E{\surprisalf{X}}}
&& \text{(entropy is expected surprisal)} \\
&= b^{\sum_x \P(X=x) \log_b \rarityf{x}}
&& \text{(surprisal is the logarithm of the rarity)} \\
&= \prod_x b^{\P(X=x) \log_b \rarityf{x}}
&& \text{(a sum in the exponent is a product)} \\
&= \prod_x \rarityf{x}^{\P(X=x)}
&& \text{(} b^{\log_b y} = y \text{)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
